slides.title: The first *30 seconds* decide the other thirty minutes
replace: SUBJECT: a head thrown back mid-shout, the left half dragged into long taffy streaks.
COMPOSITION: the sharp half sits upper right; the melt runs off to the lower left across white.
COLOUR: everything tinted hot magenta.
SUBJECT: a small figure whose legs dissolve into drips running off the bottom of the frame.
COMPOSITION: the figure is small and high right; white emptiness below.
COLOUR: everything tinted deep orange-red.

slides.title: Nobody stays for the *warm-up*
replace: SUBJECT: a closed mouth whose lower lip stretches sideways into a single long drip.
COMPOSITION: the mouth sits upper right; the drip crosses to the lower left.
COLOUR: everything tinted electric blue-violet.
SUBJECT: an ear pulled into a dozen thin horizontal streaks.
COMPOSITION: the ear is top right; streaks fan out left across white.
COLOUR: everything tinted acid lime yellow-green.

slides.title: Move your best line to the *top*
replace: SUBJECT: a hand holding scissors, the blades smeared into liquid points.
COMPOSITION: the hand enters top right; the smear runs down-left.
COLOUR: everything tinted acid lime yellow-green.

slides.title: Start at the *punchline*
replace: SUBJECT: a microphone whose head melts downward into a single fat drip.
COMPOSITION: the microphone stands in the right third; white to the left.
COLOUR: everything tinted hot pink.

slides.title: Six tools, *one* pass
replace: SUBJECT: a curtain of long thin drips hanging down from the top edge across pure white, no figure at all.
COMPOSITION: the drips are dense at the top and thin out to nothing by the middle; the lower half is clean white.
COLOUR: everything tinted electric blue-violet.

slides.title: Your cold open, found for you
replace: SUBJECT: a face split — one half sharp, the other pulled into a wide fan of streaks.
COMPOSITION: sharp half upper right, fan across the lower left.
COLOUR: everything tinted acid lime yellow-green.
